metric.name: startup_ttid_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.startups;
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.time_to_display;
WITH
  cold AS (
    SELECT s.package, d.time_to_initial_display AS ns
    FROM android_startups AS s
    JOIN android_startup_time_to_display AS d USING (startup_id)
    WHERE s.startup_type = 'cold'
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT package FROM cold GROUP BY package ORDER BY count(*) DESC, package LIMIT 1
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ns) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM cold
    WHERE package = (SELECT package FROM app) AND ns IS NOT NULL
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n + 1) / 2) AS value

claims.text: Median cold-start time to initial display increased from 839.504417 ms in the baseline to 854.851167 ms in the current trace, a delta of 15.346750 ms.

claims.text: The individual cold-start TTID samples overlap substantially: the baseline values range from 801.601458 ms to 1006.860583 ms, while the current values range from 818.441458 ms to 895.549625 ms, so one capture per side cannot establish that the 15.346750 ms median shift exceeds run-to-run variation.

The range contains a widget refresh-period resource change and source/comment-only UI changes, but the trace evidence does not localize the TTID shift to any changed code, so no culprit can be attributed.
